subject: Long x axis text- separate into two lines

messages.author: 09769225ad45054d
messages.subject: Long x axis text- separate into two lines
parts:
I have a data with a long x axis text which I want to place it on two lines. How can I achieve this feature?  

Many Thanks


Data

structure(list(Outcome = c("All", "Previous AMI", "Previous other CVD", 
"Previous Respiratory Diseases", "All", "Previous AMI", "Previous other CVD", 
"Previous Respiratory Diseases", "All", "Previous AMI", "Previous other CVD", 
"Previous Respiratory Diseases"), variable = structure(c(1L, 
1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("Total", 
"Male", "Female"), class = "factor"), value = c(136629L, 27269L, 
68219L, 28517L, 62767L, 14362L, 32917L, 14163L, 73862L, 12796L, 
35304L, 14355L)), .Names = c("Outcome", "variable", "value"), row.names = c(NA, 
-12L), class = "data.frame")


Script used:

ggplot(data1,aes(x=Outcome,y=value,fill=variable))+ geom_bar(stat='identity',position='dodge') +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y="") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) + 
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=14, face="bold")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(colour="blue", size=16, face="bold"))  +
   theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size="14"),axis.text=element_text(size=14,face="bold")) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,150000,25000)) +
  scale_fill_discrete("")

messages.author: 09769225ad45054d
messages.subject: Re: Long x axis text- separate into two lines
parts:
Hi All,

I have added the following line which has solved my problem.
 scale_x_discrete("", labels = c("All", "Previous AMI", "Previous other \n CVD" ,"Previous   \n Respiratory Diseases"))
